For the software product **Atticus** at **askatticus.ai**, the product was directly created and provided by developer/founder **Darlin Alberto** (operating under the project/provider brand **Atticus AI**):

* **Product & Domain:** Atticus / Atticus AI at `askatticus.ai` (contract analysis and negotiation tool).
* **Developer/Provider Evidence:**
  * In the official product launch announcement on Hacker News, creator Darlin Alberto stated: *"My name is Darlin and along with @controtie we've been working on an app to make contract negotiations easier for consultants, freelancers and other individuals... At Atticus AI, we're on a mission to make legal understanding more [accessible]"*.
  * The Vercel AI Accelerator directory identifies the builder directly: *"Darlin Alberto – Building Atticus, LLMs to help everyday people increase their understanding of legal contracts"*.
  * Professional bios and his presentation (*"Startup Lessons from Building an AI Legal Assistant | Darlin Alberto"*) document Alberto as the builder and co-founder of Atticus AI.
